entities.summary: A 48 km high-alpine road across the Hohe Tauern, including the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe branch and 36 engineered bends.
entities.description: The seasonal road starts at Ferleiten, crosses the main Alpine divide through Hochtor, reaches the glacier-facing Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe branch, and continues to Heiligenblut. The operator publishes 48 km and 36 bends; opening depends on snow and current high-mountain conditions.
entities.whyWorthwhile: It combines a complete mountain crossing with a long glacier-view spur, sustained high-altitude road engineering and a sequence of distinct ecological zones rather than a single summit viewpoint.

entities.summary: A 34 km seasonal crossing between Innerkrems and Ebene Reichenau through the rounded Nockberge highlands.
entities.description: The road links its two official ticket offices through the UNESCO Nockberge Biosphere Reserve, climbing through larch and Swiss-pine forest to open alpine terrain and the 2,042 m Eisentalhöhe. The operator lists 52 bends and an early-May-to-late-October season, subject to mountain conditions.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Its value is the long, coherent transition from forest to open pasture across two high points, with gentler sightlines and a different landscape character from the sharper central-Alpine pass roads.
